verdict.rationale: Mercury ships its own hosted MCP server (https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp) that lets AI assistants work with accounts, transactions, recipients and cards. Its docs say users can query balances, transaction history and account data in natural language, with examples like "What's my balance today?" and "Graph my last 6 months of transactions". Official agent skills (e.g. analyze-spend, receipt-upload) also let agents drive the Mercury CLI. Missing for 10: clear evidence that natural-language commands can perform write operations (payments, card issuance) rather than mostly read queries; any natural-language interface built into the Mercury app itself; independent or hands-on confirmation that the natural-language operation works as described.
